title: Non-anchor position period prediction v7
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-only period rule before any candidate-word, key-material, route, or public-anchor-fragment scoring. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery is limited to an explicit structural rule over absolute K4 positions, and evaluation must use future source-documented non-anchor observations.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared residue classes from the registered period set before any public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set fixed before evaluation: 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13
Deterministic residue-class rule emitted before observing new source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
A committed held-out non-anchor position set not derived from public clue alignments or known anchor plaintext fragments
controls: multiple-comparison correction across registered periods and residue classes
